name: tariro-studio-monorepo
description: Tariro Studio — visual programming IDE for the Tariro robotics, electronics and IoT kits (Omorfo Tech Labs)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tariro-studio/core && npm run build -w @tariro-studio/extensions && npm run dev -w @tariro-studio/app
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tariro-studio/core && npm run build -w @tariro-studio/extensions && npm run build -w @tariro-studio/app
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @tariro-studio/app
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @tariro-studio/app
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
